Install what is missing and refresh what is outdated; skip hand-edited ones

Usage:
  brickkit skills update [flags]

Examples:
  brickkit skills update
  brickkit skills update --lang zh

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for update
      --lang string   Reinstall using this language (en|zh), and remember it for this project from now on

Global Flags:
      --log-level string   Level of the JSON logs on stderr (debug | info | warn | error | off) (default "off")
